scripts.preinstall: node -e "var v = process.version; if (!process.env.CI && !/^v20\./.test(v)) { console.error(''); console.error('❌ Wrong Node.js version!'); console.error('   This project requires Node.js 20.19.x'); console.error('   Current version: ' + v); console.error(''); console.error('💡 Fix this by:'); console.error('   1. Install fnm: https://fnm.vercel.app'); console.error('   2. Run: fnm use --install-if-missing'); console.error('   3. Then: npm install'); console.error(''); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.dev: npm run dev:kill && concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:server:log" "npm run dev:web:log"
scripts.dev:server:log: node scripts/kill-ports.cjs --only server && node scripts/spawn-log.js tmp/server.log npm run dev:server
scripts.dev:web:log: node scripts/kill-ports.cjs --only web && node scripts/spawn-log.js tmp/web.log npm run dev:web
scripts.dev:e2e: node scripts/run-with-ports.cjs --e2e --kill-first concurrently --kill-others --names server,web npm:dev:e2e:server npm:dev:e2e:web
scripts.typecheck: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 tsc --noEmit --project apps/server/tsconfig.json && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run knip
